explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 92 named tracks across Boomkat's current September 2026 electronic/techno arrivals, targeted Ghostly, Short Span, TraTraTrax and Cosmocities pages, plus current Bandcamp and catalogue cross-checks. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Jay Mitta — Sawa and Lotic — Carried remain removed after severe listener feedback; Luigi Tozzi — Tender Is The Night remains positively retained. No placement disturbs those resolved decisions.

Completed Runs 227, 228, 231 and 232 selected identities were excluded; proposed boundaries were compared against the previous five completed discovery runs and recently repeated candidate boundaries were avoided.
Every ranked artist/title pair was checked against canonical state, target-local discovery history, rejection/PARKED state and the global utility ledger.
No proposed placement splits Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.

The top three leads come from three different releases and all carry candidate-specific evidence. Lower-ranked same-release leads retain individual descriptions; I Gotta is explicitly ranked last because its evidence is weaker.

Ghost Dubs' current Oblique material was inspected but excluded because its source foregrounds dread, cinematic darkness and related threat-coded framing. This is a run-level prioritization after direct listener evidence, not a blanket intensity, dub or genre ban.

6. K Wata — There Will Be Love
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Lusine — Melting Days, with exact notes for Bird's Eye and other individually described tracks. https://boomkat.com/products/melting-days
CURRENT / EMERGING WINDOW: K Wata — Give U Space on Short Span, with individual notes for Looking Glass, There Will Be Love and I Gotta. https://boomkat.com/products/give-u-space

ADJACENT / COMPILATION WINDOW: Denshi Ongaku No Bigaku Vol. 3 on Cosmocities, with individual descriptions for Deep Track Jazz, Jump Rope Music, Little Secrets, Fatality 4 and Skygazer. https://boomkat.com/products/denshi-ongaku-no-bigaku-vol-3
CURRENT CROSS-CHECK: Boomkat new releases and TraTraTrax's Los Totes Vol. 3 were inspected; previously retained or persistent identities were excluded.
OVERLOOKED / CATALOGUE CROSS-CHECK: Bandcamp rhythm-led catalogue material and Deepblak/Cold Blow context were inspected without padding the final lead set.
